json_ld.description: DESCRIPTIONMinipresso GR2, the next evolution of the Minipresso GR. With a smaller and lighter form factor, it continues to deliver exceptional in-cup espresso quality. We have significantly improved the renowned Minipresso in two crucial areas: sustainability and user experience.Experience the ultimate coffee customization with our innovative new design featuring a built-in adjustable basket. Discover the freedom to select between 8 or 12g of pre-ground coffee, allowing you to explore and effortlessly achieve your perfect espresso strength. Elevating convenience to new heights, the Minipresso GR2 includes additional accessories, such as a dosing funnel and a drip tray, ensuring a seamless brewing experience. Unleash your coffee creativity and enjoy unparalleled convenience with the Minipresso GR2.The Minipresso GR2 is not only more compact but also incorporates eco-friendly measures. We have prioritized sustainability by reducing plastic material usage and incorporating biobased materials in some parts.
